# GuestSetGo

> GuestSetGo gives holiday home guests a guided walkthrough of the property, with photo instructions for heating, Wi-Fi, appliances and check-out shared by one QR code or link.

## Home

- [Home](https://www.guestsetgo.com): An overview of GuestSetGo and its digital guest guides.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://www.guestsetgo.com): See the pricing section on the homepage for guest-guide hosting plans.

## How it works

- [How it works](https://www.guestsetgo.com): The homepage explains how to create a property guide, share a QR code or link, and guide guests through their stay.

## Blog

- [Blog](https://www.guestsetgo.com/blog): Practical articles for holiday-home hosts.

## Templates

- [Sample guest guide](https://www.guestsetgo.com/sample): Explore a fictional property's guide as an example for your own.
- [DIY holiday let welcome book](https://www.guestsetgo.com/blog/diy-holiday-let-welcome-book): Guidance on structuring and writing your own welcome book.

## Contact

- [Contact](https://www.guestsetgo.com): Find the contact email in the homepage footer.
